name: replace_white_noise_with_pink_noise
mechanism: Replaces white noise with pink noise using an FFT-based 1/f spectral scaling method to generate more realistic murmurs and ambient noise with natural energy roll-off.
code_snippet: X = np.fft.rfft(np.random.randn(N)); X = X / np.sqrt(indices); return np.fft.irfft(X, n=N)

name: add_heart_sound_texture
mechanism: Adds low-pass filtered random noise scaled by the amplitude envelope to the heart sound waveforms to reduce synthetic purity and simulate realistic physiological texture.
code_snippet: noise = signal.filtfilt(b, a, np.random.randn(len(t))); sound += env * noise * 0.3
